candidate.answerReason: The two selling prices are 115% and 85% of the same cost, so their ratio is 115:85 = 23:17.

methods.label: Express both prices using the cost
methods.explanation:
Both percentages are based on the same cost, so express both selling prices as multiples of that cost. Let the cost be \(C>0\) dollars. A loss subtracts \(15\%\) of the cost, while a profit adds \(15\%\) of the cost. Thus
\[
x=(1-0.15)C=0.85C,
\qquad y=(1+0.15)C=1.15C.
\]
The common positive factor \(C\) cancels from the ratio:
\[
y:x=1.15:0.85=115:85=23:17.
\]
Therefore the ratio is \(23:17\), choice A.
